activity_summary: You and Anne came in and sat. The rest of the house was already at the board, and your mother, Richard, and Edmund were among them. Joan wanted the bread to be bread. You did not bring the path in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, reported nothing new, and left the boats where they were.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the path off the board.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Had already had the three, and cleared the board after.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Was at the board for the knife, and then went up.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Told the arch until he was allowed to stop.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the song off the board, and left the boats outside.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, and was not given a subject.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Was at the board, and was not given a subject.

entities.name: Edmund Shakespeare
entities.context: Was at the board, and was not given a subject.

entities.name: the loaf

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sit, before the bread is asked to be a speech.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: What we walked can stay where we walked it.
